ONBOARDING · INTERNAL CONTROL ATTESTATIONS

Partner onboarding readiness

Authorised operators may record independent first and second reviews of seven required controls. No sensitive supporting documents or actual bank information are collected on this page.

Strict staging boundary: A completed review is not a signed agreement, KYC certification, regulatory approval, activated business partner account or authorisation to pay commissions. All real financial integrations remain closed.

Checking operator authorisation…

Review applications and issue pilot codes

The preparer and second reviewer must be different verified operator accounts. The database rejects approvals by the partner's own account. Every review attempt that passes validation is recorded with the actual authenticated reviewer identity. Rejected checks cannot be reopened using this preview.
